facts.material: housing: Lexan (polycarbonate) plastic; bracket: cast aluminum
facts.function: external housing/shell enclosing a traffic signal head; bracket attaches the traffic light

gri_path: GRI 1: heading 8530 covers electrical signaling, safety or traffic control equipment for roads and parts thereof
Section XVI note 2(b): the housing is not itself a good of a specific heading of ch. 84/85 and is suitable solely or principally for traffic signals, so it goes with them in 8530.90
Section XVI note 1(g)/Section XV note 2 checked: the housing is not a part of general use

rejected_alternatives.reason: plastic articles n.e.s.o.i.; the housing is a dedicated part of traffic signaling equipment and goes with it under Section XVI note 2(b)
covers parts of signaling equipment for cycles and motor vehicles, not roadside traffic signals
aluminum articles; would only apply to the bracket if it were a general-purpose mounting not dedicated to traffic signals (classify separately)

missing_facts: classify separately: cast aluminum bracket (likely also 8530.90.00.00 if dedicated to traffic signals)
classification.rationale: The Lexan external housing is identifiable as a part of a traffic signal, which is road traffic control equipment of heading 8530. Under Section XVI note 2(b), a part suitable solely or principally for that apparatus is classified with it, in 8530.90.00.00. NY N359472 (in force) classified a housing for a roadway pedestrian warning light in 8530.90.0000. The first-named article (the housing) decides; the bracket should be classified separately, most likely in the same line.
